chapter: Will Vodery and the road shows
title: Joe Jordan and Josephine Baker's music
summary: Whaley says Joe Jordan wrote Josephine Baker's music and led the band at the 46th Street Theatre where Whaley played.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you ever hear of him?
Yes, he came from Chicago here, right?
Yeah, he used to orchestrate and have a band with Josephine Baker. He wrote all of the music for Josephine Baker when she was in show business.
Yeah, Joe Jordan. I was in his band when we was in the 46th Street Theater.
46th and -- off of Broadway. We did a show there.
What's the name of the show?
If you can think of it.
Who else was in the show? If you can think of it.
